correctness.rationale: The monomial space has basis 1,x,x^2,y,xy and evaluation is injective for t=q-1>=3. Each word is A(x)+yB(x). Classify B=0, torus-nonvanishing B (2t polynomials), and B=beta(x-r) (t^2 polynomials); for each, elementary first and second root moments of deg<=2 A give exactly the enumerator coefficients and sum q^5. Directly checking maximum zero counts gives d=t(t-2), d2=d+1 and the support factorizations; collinear fixed-x generator columns prove dual d=3 while pairwise distinctness excludes 1,2. Own independent small-prime-field brute force enumerated 5^5=3125 and 7^5=16807 words, matching all weights and counts; q=4 exponent collision is accounted for analytically.

Correctness requires finite fields of prime-power order q>=4 and evaluation ONLY on torus (Fq*)^2, not all rational scroll points; finite q=5,7 checks cannot establish universal formula.
